On-device mode uses Android's on-device speech service. Availability and languages depend on your phone. The optional default speech service may send audio to its provider.

Translation uses Google Translate through ML Kit on your phone. Language packs need an initial internet download, typically about 30 MB per language. The SDK may collect operational diagnostics under Google's terms.

This app does not save microphone audio or conversation text, and it stops the microphone when you leave the app. Settings and downloaded language packs remain.

This is automatic translation. Recognition and translation may be wrong, especially with noise or mixed languages. Partial captions and pauses between recognition sessions depend on your phone's speech service.
Translation packs will be downloaded to this phone. Wi-Fi is recommended. No microphone audio is needed for this step.
